subtopic: 04 · Graphs and Periodicity of Trigonometric Functions
title: Periods, ranges and amplitudes

board_content.text: Example 2 — range and period of 3 + 2 sin x
Amplitude $2$, vertical shift $3$: range $=[3-2,\,3+2]=[1,5]$. The $\sin x$ is unscaled, so period $2\pi$.
Example 3 — amplitude and period of −4 cos(x/3)
The minus flips the graph vertically but changes neither amplitude nor period.

segments_english.text: Three quick reads to make the scaling rule automatic.

For the periods: sine three x divides two pi by three, giving two pi over three. Tangent two x uses the tangent base pi over two, so pi over two. And cosine of x over two divides two pi by one half, which is four pi, a stretched, slower wave.
Second, the range and period of three plus two sine x.
The amplitude is two and the vertical shift is three, so the range is three minus two to three plus two, that is one to five. The x inside sine is unscaled, so the period is just two pi.
Third, the amplitude and period of minus four cosine of x over three.
Amplitude is the size of minus four, which is four. Period is two pi over one third, which is six pi.
Notice the minus sign flips the graph upside down, but it touches neither the amplitude nor the period, both come from sizes only.

segments_hinglish.text: Scaling rule automatic करने के लिए तीन quick reads.

Periods के लिए: sine three x, two pi को three से divide, यानी two pi over three. Tangent two x tangent base pi over two use करता है, so pi over two. और cosine of x over two, two pi को one half से divide, यानी four pi, एक stretched, धीमी wave.
दूसरा, three plus two sine x का range और period.
Amplitude two और vertical shift three, so range है three minus two से three plus two, यानी one to five. Sine के अंदर x unscaled है, so period बस two pi.
तीसरा, minus four cosine of x over three का amplitude और period.
Amplitude है minus four का size, यानी four. Period है two pi over one third, यानी six pi.
ध्यान दीजिए minus sign graph को उल्टा flip करता है, पर ना amplitude ना period को छूता है, दोनों सिर्फ़ sizes से आते हैं.
